name: SwiftBasics
title: Swift Basics
about: Every Swift Fundamentals example as a program you can run, change and run again: values and types, numbers and strings, optionals, collections, decisions and loops, functions and closures. Each console shows exactly what the course page prints.
notes: Mistake examples cannot compile, so each one shows the real compiler message next to the working fix.
Add the launch argument -autorun to run every example as soon as its card appears, which suits a projector.
